Detailed Description

The CMDU server is a component to send and receive CMDU messages between local processes.

In this implementation of the

See also
CmduServer interface, the connection between communicating processes is established with a server socket. The framing protocol used is defined by the CMDU parser and serializer objects given constructor.

Adds a new connection.

Registers given event handlers for the connected socket so the appropriate action is taken whenever data is received or socket get disconnected.

Adds the connection object to the list of current socket connections so event handlers that have been registered in the event loop can be removed on exit.

Parameters

connectionConnection object used to send/receive data.

◆ remove_connection()

bool beerocks::CmduServerImpl::remove_connection ( int  fd,
bool  remove_handlers = false 
)
private

Removes connection.

Removes event handlers for the connected socket and removes the connection from the list of current connections.

This method gets called when connection is closed, an error occurs on the socket and on exit.

When connection is closed by the other peer there is no need to remove installed event handlers for the disconnected socket as it has already been done by the event loop itself. It is only on exit when we have to explicitly remove event handlers from the event loop for the remaining connections.

Parameters
fdFile descriptor of the socket used by the connection.
remove_handlersFlag to signal if event handlers must be removed from event loop.
Returns
true on success and false otherwise.
